prompt:
Do a UX review of our product home page from this measurement sheet. The visitor wants to start a free trial.

Measurement sheet (viewport 1440 by 900 px, page height 2400 px):
- persistent header, the same on every screen of the product: logo, 6 nav links (Product, Pricing, Docs, Blog, Company, Sign in) and a search box
- first screen content: one h1 "Plan projects with your team" at top 220 px, one sentence under it saying who it is for, one filled button "Start free trial" and one text link "See pricing"
- sections in order: hero 0 / 900; Features 900 / 800; Customers 1700 / 400; Footer 2100 / 300
- clickable controls in the first screen: 9 in total, 8 of them in the persistent header, 1 filled primary button, 1 text link
- repeated blocks: none
output:
## UX review: Product home page

Reviewed: A measurement sheet of the home page (viewport 1440 by 900 px, page height 2400 px), covering the first screen, section order and the header controls. Layout input: measurement sheet.
Main goal: Start a free trial
Steps to main goal: 1 (Home page)
Findings: 0 (S1: 0, S2: 0, S3: 0, S4: 0)

### Findings

No findings.

### Not reviewed

- Contrast, focus styles, spacing and type scales: a visual polish pass.
- Semantics, ARIA and screen-reader output: an accessibility audit.
- Wording of labels and messages: a copy edit.

### Open questions

- "Start free trial" button: the sheet does not show what happens after the click (sign-up form, number of steps, what is asked). The step count and the rules on feedback, errors, remembered values and steps cannot be judged.
- "Start free trial" and "See pricing": the sheet does not say how they look. It states "one filled button" and "one text link" but does not show whether the header links and search box look clickable.
- Header and hero controls: no sizes or gaps are given, so whether the user can hit "Start free trial" without hitting a neighbour is not shown.
- "Start free trial" in the sections below the first screen (Features, Customers): the sheet does not show whether the main action is repeated there or whether Sign in is visibly distinct from the other nav links.

### Severity scale

- S1 Blocker: the user cannot complete the main goal, or loses data or money.
- S2 Major: the user completes the main goal only after a wrong action, an error or a second attempt.
- S3 Minor: the user completes the main goal at the first attempt, but more slowly.
- S4 Note: the result and the speed do not change; the place departs from the rule.
